read.title: Proposal: Winter Care Bundle
read.text:
Team,

Our data shows that 35% of customers who buy the moisturizing cream also buy the lip balm within a month. I suggest we pair these two items as a winter care bundle on Amazon.

The bundle would sell for $29, which is 10% less than buying both items separately. This should help us cross-sell the lip balm and increase our average order value.

The hand cream is also a natural fit, but adding it would raise the price too much. Please share your thoughts by Monday.

Jimin

write.en: Suggest to your team that you sell the toner and toner pads as a bundle.
write.model:
Hi team,

Many customers who buy our toner also buy the toner pads. I suggest we pair the toner with the pads as a bundle at a small discount. This would help us cross-sell the pads and raise our average order value. Let me know what you think.

Thanks,
Minsu
